target: positive at an as_of date if the account held a role in ('intermediary', 'attacker_controlled') that had materialised by that date: intermediary = it had received AND sent money of its scenario; attacker_controlled = it had received money of its scenario (the generator's corrected 'materialised' rule, evaluated at as_of). Unmaterialised suspicious roles, victims, innocent counterparties, look-alikes and ordinary accounts are negatives.

snapshots.reading: Each row is one account as of one date; an account contributes one row per as_of date at which it has >= 5 records. All rows of an account and of its scenario instance are in the same split.

held_out_variants.multi_hop:slow: Each hop waits 6-40 hours instead of minutes, so 'forwarded within the hour' never fires.
held_out_variants.split:structured: The split uses many transfers under 10,000 instead of a few large ones.
held_out_variants.takeover:after_dormancy: The account had no activity for 45+ days before the takeover burst.

selected.rule: simplest set unless a richer one gains >= 0.01 validation PR-AUC; account-age features are excluded by default because they can flag new accounts before they do anything
selected.selection_rule: highest validation PR-AUC (all snapshots) among exportable models (logistic regression, XGBoost)

cold_ledger_test.split: cold ledger (disjoint accounts), as of day 120

served_demo_ledger.split: served demo ledger, as of day 90

cold_seen_variants.split: cold ledger excluding held-out variant accounts

temporal_test.split: temporal test: instances starting on/after day 84, scored as of day 120

design.fit_validation_groups: scenario instances whose last transfer is before the cutoff, split 75/25 by instance, plus ordinary accounts (hash buckets 0.5-1.0 fit, 0-0.25 validation)
design.test_groups: scenario instances whose first transfer is on/after the cutoff plus ordinary accounts in hash bucket 0.25-0.5 (never used for fitting or selection)

as_of_before_scenario.design: as_of = the 7-day grid date at least 1 day before the scenario's first transfer; ordinary baseline = 600 seeded ordinary cold accounts at the same dates (accounts with < 5 records by then abstain)
as_of_before_scenario.reading: Scores use only records up to as_of. A before-scenario flag rate close to the matched ordinary rate means the model flags these accounts no more than ordinary accounts at the same date (no foresight); a much higher rate would mean they already looked unusual before acting.

previous_model.labels_it_was_trained_on: ledger-end snapshot; roles from accounts.ground_truth_label (unmaterialised suspicious roles counted as positives)

promotion.owner_decision: Not served. The automatic promotion rule passed, but the owner decided (2026-11-01) to keep v3-account-1.1.0 as a challenger until its long-history false-positive rate and train-validation gap are resolved; see ml/reports/account_model_champion_challenger.json. The served champion is v3-account-1.0.0 at ml/artifacts/v3/account_model.

promotion.rule: promote only if validation PR-AUC at ledger end is not lower than the previous model's by more than 0.01 AND validation false-positive rate on accounts with < 60 days of records is lower; both on the current labels
